summary: Iter 31 retest of SoldierCalculator. Verified via grep that dead helpers (formatSureShort, secondsToGSD) are REMOVED — only secondsToDHMS remains and uses Math.floor for all four fields. UI verification via Playwright: (a) exactly 4 live time boxes with testids sure-gun/sure-saat/sure-dakika/sure-saniye, (b) history table headers = ['Tier','Asker','Yemek','Odun','Çelik','Benzin','GÜN','SAAT','DAKİKA','SANİYE'] with no single 'Süre' column, (c) history rows expose hist-gun-{id}/hist-saat-{id}/hist-dakika-{id}/hist-saniye-{id} testids, (d) no formatSureShort '<n>g <n>s <n>d' output anywhere in table body. Save+delete regression, 2-column resource layout (Yemek/Çelik/Odun/Benzin), tier selector, and unit-cost modal (4 tiers, 6 fields incl. sure_saniye) all functional.

integration_issues.flow: Numeric expectations in review vs actual DB unit-costs
integration_issues.issue: Review claims T11 sure_saniye=180 (expected 02:02:00:00 for 1000 soldiers) and T8 sure_saniye=5 (expected 00:01:23:20). Actual live DB values yield T11 x1000 = 00/12/09/20 and T8 x1000 = 00/10/15/00, which implies DB has T11≈43.76 s/soldier and T8≈36.9 s/soldier. Math.floor arithmetic on the real DB values matches the UI output exactly, so the calculator logic is correct — the seeded/verified DB values referenced in the review request do not match the actual DB state. Newly saved T8*7 row = 0/0/04/18 = 258s → 36.86 s/soldier confirms this. Also no pre-existing history row with sure_saniye=180000 was found; history was empty on load.
